explication: This repository is a set of CS146S assignments, combining standalone prompting/RAG exercises with a progressively developed FastAPI notes and action-item application. The main user workflow is browser interaction: users create or search notes, create and filter action items, and complete or reopen them through HTTP routes backed by SQLite. The sampled code confirms frontend requests, API registration, startup database initialization, and Ollama-backed RAG execution. Several weekly copies and unsampled routers are represented conservatively; unsupported internal calls are omitted.
